d: A youth with a slender build, featuring champagne blonde hair styled in a side-parted bob with a single curled tendril and a braided crown adorned with red beads. The eyes are a pale sky blue with a calm, neutral expression on a youthful face. The outfit consists of a brown sleeveless dress with a ruffled hem, layered under a burgundy velvet capelet with white lace trim and silver stud detailing, paired with a large lace collar, a red neck ribbon, and red criss-cross lace-up flats. Signature details include a gold astronomical armillary sphere held in the hand and a series of small red and blue star-shaped marks trailing down the left leg.
